verdict.rationale: Agents run in a checkout on the developer's own machine and open PRs from their GitHub account, so the in-progress work is locally accessible in their editor and terminal (docs-3). The Agents view shows each worker's held task and its last message (docs-8). The CLI manages tasks from a terminal (docs-16), and intentions can be copied into a normal development process (docs-31). However, no documented mechanism lets a developer explicitly take over, pause, or redirect a claimed in-progress task; that is only implied by the local-execution model. Missing for 10: an explicit take-over or handoff flow for in-progress tasks, a way to redirect or reassign a claimed task, a browser-based takeover, and hands-on corroboration.
